summary: Coeur Mining filed an 8-K/A to amend its prior report on the completion of its acquisition of all outstanding common shares of New Gold via a Plan of Arrangement on March 20, 2026. Coeur, through a wholly-owned Canadian subsidiary, acquired New Gold, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary. The transaction was previously announced on November 2, 2025. This amendment provides Item 9.01 financial statements, including New Gold's audited financials and pro forma combined financial information. No deal terms (price, premium) are stated in this excerpt. The acquisition closed with regulatory approval; watch for integration execution and pro forma earnings impact.
